## Project history
- Summer 2025: dorofo idea — mod for MAX focused on privacy (almost no mods existed then)
- September 2025: GitHub v0.0.1 named **«MAX MOD by dorofo»** — limited file access, slightly limited trackers, some UI text changes
- 25 January 2026: **MaxVibe 1.0.0** after AshelonWar joined; later versions use MaxVibe *.*.*
- 20 March 2026: **2.0.0** global — first chat encryption
- 25 April 2026: **3.0.0** global — not the most successful release
- 29 July 2026: **4.0.0** global — very powerful, later removed by the developer
- August 2026: best recommended version **4.1.1**
